item.description: CHATHAM/HARWICH – The Monomoy Regional School Committee has announced the finalists for its open Superintendent position. item.title: Vehicle fire causes delay on Route 6 ramp in Barnstable
item.description: BARNSTABLE – A vehicle fire caused delays for a time for people getting off Route 6 in Barnstable. The fire happened sometime before noon Tuesday on the westbound ramp from Route 6 to Route 132. No injuries were reported. item.title: Vehicle strikes pillar at CVS in Chatham
item.description: CHATHAM – A Lexus SUV struck a pillar at the CVS/Pharmacy on Queen Anne Road in Chatham early Tuesday afternoon. No injuries were reported. A building inspector was called to check the damage. Chatham Police are investigating. Photos by Jake O’Callaghan/CWN The post Vehicle strikes pillar at CVS in Chatham appeared first on CapeCod.com.

item.title: Firefighters rescue man stuck in the mud in Wellfleet
item.description: WELLFLEET – Wellfleet Firefighters responded to assist a man who reportedly got stuck in the mud up to his waist. The scene unfolded about 4 PM Tuesday off Nauset Road as crews used an inflatable boat to reach and free the victim. No injury was reported.
